- **Eastbank** — [Hollis, June 9, 2026](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1781019960000039): Ticket **PD-4821** covers a receiving-door import mismatch: E1/E2 in the import file vs. 01/02 on the booking sheet.
- **Pine Crossing** — [Your June 9, 2026 post](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1781020080000040): The morning receiver reported that the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift.
- **Wichita** — [Your July 2, 2025 reply](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1751466060000007) mentions a check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher right after [Tobias mentioned Marrow’s office hours](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1751466000000006). That ties Wichita to Marrow by context, but doesn’t confirm it was part of the rollout.
